divisions.title: Emptied
divisions.theme: Where you go, I will go
divisions.summary: Famine, three graves, and a Moabite widow who refuses to let go of Naomi’s God.

divisions.title: Gleaning
divisions.summary: Ruth gathers barley in the field of a kinsman who covers her with deliberate kindness.

divisions.title: The Threshing Floor
divisions.summary: At midnight Naomi’s plan puts the claim of redemption in Boaz’s hands.

divisions.title: Redeemed
divisions.summary: At the gate the nearer kinsman steps aside; Ruth becomes the great-grandmother of David.

chapterSummaries.1: Famine drives Naomi to Moab, three widows on the road back, Orpah turns and Ruth clings
chapterSummaries.2: Ruth gleans in the field of Boaz, favor at the meal, Naomi hears the redeemer’s name
chapterSummaries.3: Naomi’s instruction, midnight at the threshing floor, six measures of barley
chapterSummaries.4: The nearer kinsman declines, the sandal at the gate, Obed born and the line to David
